scope: One-shot synthetic native pose/racket observation storage, indexed render-like reads and complete existing JSON exports. No actual pipeline/render/video/model/inference/HTTP/product workload or scientific qualification.
softwarePrerequisites: At launch require the retained class and actual pipeline integration GREEN suites with unchanged sources and exact JUnit counts. Also require the fresh backend_full/receipt.json PASSED, every actual test passing without failures/errors/skips, identical complete source inventories/interpreters and all owned identities retired. Bind those actual receipts, logs, interpreters and source maps before and after the synthetic measurements; never infer current counts from older event units.
frozenSanitizer: AST-select only sanitize_json_value; compile that single definition against NumPy/Any; require current definition AST identical. Never import the frozen or current whole pipeline.
oldPath: Append every constructed pose/racket frame to two ordinary resident lists; sanitize the whole existing output and json.dump(indent=2,allow_nan=false) using native Windows text newlines and no final newline.
newPath: Append every constructed pose/racket frame to two actual IdentityFrameSequence instances; actual write_identity_frame_json streams the same unchanged sanitizer and exact existing output codec. No full observation array materialized.
ordinaryImportsFairness: Both child modes import the same NumPy and identity storage module after exact actual interpreter sampling acknowledgement; old does not instantiate the disk sequence.
fixture: One exclusive complete JSONL file per pair, generated one frame at a time without NumPy. Every frame includes all 17 native-joint observations for two ordered integer identities, adjacent IEEE float precision and signed zero; all full DETECTED/MISSING racket fields. Alternating identity insertion order is preserved. Both children parse the exact same immutable input bytes; every row/count/native field is checked.
independentNativeFidelity: Complete observations are encoded one frame at a time by a separate typed native codec that packs IEEE float bits and preserves integer dictionary keys, order, booleans and list/tuple distinctions. Both outputs must match the fixture's full native digest and each other's complete bytes.
indexedReads: All frames by integer index, every pose identity/joint and racket observation; bounded previous/current/next, negative and first-two slice reads. No actual graphics/media rendering.
groundMotionScope: Complete player_motion schema retains unknown/empty ground-motion summaries, including all summary keys and empty samples. This isolates pose/racket storage; unrelated ground-motion arrays/algorithms are not measured or bounded by these observations.
timing: Separate perf_counter spans: complete fixture parse/native construction/append, indexed render-like reads, full player_motion serialization, full racket serialization, complete independent fidelity serialization, hashing, imports, fixture generation, whole child and monitored wall. No profiler or method patch; no repeated trials or throughput/accuracy/full-match claim.
memory: Record actual interpreter Windows OS peak working set and peak process commit (peak_pagefile) separately from sampled owned-tree RSS/private. Peak process commit is not paging-file disk use. Imported/runtime memory and output fidelity work count toward actual process peaks. RSS can double-count shared pages; samples can miss brief peaks.
disk: Record actual database main and sidecar logical file lengths before cleanup separately from result output bytes. Pending transaction sidecars are retained in that pre-cleanup sum. Successful actual sequence contexts must remove their exact scratch database/sidecars; abrupt guarded stops preserve every partial file.
guardRationale: Keep reviewed event-measurement guards unchanged. 180 seconds includes imports, both observation types, indexed reads, full exports/fidelity/hashes and cleanup at a maximum of 18,000 frames. This is a safety ceiling, not a performance target; a dense old list or serializer can legitimately stop under memory pressure. Preserve partial outcomes and halt later cases without relaxation or retry.
ownedProcessPolicy: Reuse reviewed OwnedProcessTree from hashbound scripts/audit/measure_candidate_storage.py. Launch only the clean interpreter redirector; track descendants by exact PID/createTime. Sample the actual child's canonical identity, atomically acknowledge, then allow NumPy/project class import and numeric work. Stop only exact remembered owned identities deepest first; require all identities retired at terminal.
sourceBindings: Prepared seal plus launch bindings, frozen/current sanitizer continuity, actual base interpreter executable before workload, all ordinary imported files before/after computation and parent terminal, every complete fixture before/after, all full output/receipt files at terminal. Reject changed bindings or model/media imports/network actions.
retention: Exclusive measurement/run; retain all fixtures, raw complete output bytes, child stdout, identity/ack, ordinary import bindings, streamed resource samples, child/resource/pair/report receipts, and any guarded partial scratch databases. No cleanup of unrelated files, prior receipts, server state or documents.
